levels.label: Beta
levels.meaning: Recorded samples only. The adapter was written from the broker's documentation and tested against recorded sample replies; it has not touched a real broker, and at least one contract case is still missing.

levels.label: Contract-tested
levels.meaning: Every contract case passes with none missing: the shared adapter harness and the order-safety cases (refusals, lost replies, stop-loss mapping, session-ended replies) on recorded replies. Still no real broker.

levels.label: Sandbox-verified
levels.meaning: Checked against the broker's own sandbox or paper environment, with the evidence recorded. Needs a complete contract level first.

levels.label: Live-verified
levels.meaning: Checked end to end with a real account, with the date and who did it recorded. Needs a complete contract level first.

dhan.evidence: Checked with a live Dhan account before this ladder existed.
dhan.note: The calendar date was not recorded at the time. The maintainer should replace null with the date of the next live re-check.
